primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." That's a rational concern. But here's what most people miss: off-the-plan means you secure today's price with a deposit and don't settle until construction completes. That gives you time for rates to stabilise — while your purchase price stays locked in. Meanwhile, rent keeps climbing. New warehouses in Truganina, 20km from Melbourne CBD. Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access. Don't let rate fear cost you more than the rates themselves.
description: Secure today's price now and settle later when rates stabilise
